emails.subject: Fall 2026 registration window is open
emails.body:
Dear Jordan Lee (Student ID W00482913),

The Fall 2026 registration window is now open for continuing undergraduates.

To submit an add or enrollment request, email registrar@westbrook.edu. Include your full name, student ID, course number, and section, for example DSCI 3300-01. Requests are processed in the order received, subject to seat availability and prerequisites.

Confirmed enrollments post to your student record and appear on your Fall 2026 schedule. Tuition and any course fees are billed to your student account.

You can browse section times, prerequisites, and open seats in the Westbrook Course Finder.

Office of the Registrar
Westbrook University

emails.subject: Advising meeting Friday
emails.body:
Hi Jordan,

This confirms our advising meeting on Friday at 2:00 pm in Hollis Hall 214.

Before we meet, please pick one data-science elective for fall that looks like a good fit so we can go over it together. Look at prerequisites, meeting times, and workload, and bring any questions you have. We'll talk through how it fits your degree plan.

See you Friday,
Dr. Elena Ruiz
Academic Advisor, Data Science Program

emails.subject: Westbrook Weekly: Spring Arts Festival, library hours, and more
emails.body:
This week at Westbrook:

- The Spring Arts Festival runs Saturday on the Central Quad, 11 am to 6 pm.
- Harmon Library extends its hours to midnight during finals weeks.
- Campus Recreation is taking intramural summer league sign-ups through May 8.
- The Eastside parking lot will be repaved May 4 to 6. Please use the North Garage.

Have a great week!
Westbrook Office of Communications
